prediabetic.label: Prediabetic glycemic pattern
prediabetic.explanation: HbA1c reflects average blood glucose over roughly 2-3 months. This value is above the optimal range and is commonly used to indicate increased risk of type 2 diabetes when persistent.
prediabetic.action: Consider a structured lifestyle program (e.g., 150+ min/week moderate exercise plus dietary pattern change) and discuss follow-up testing with a clinician.
prediabetic.evidence: Example placeholder: ADA Standards of Care (year/section to be curated).

prediabetic.label: Impaired fasting glucose pattern
prediabetic.explanation: Fasting glucose is above the typical reference range. Persistent elevations may reflect impaired glucose regulation and can co-occur with insulin resistance.
prediabetic.action: Consider lifestyle measures and discuss repeat measurements and context (medication, illness, recent diet) with a clinician.
prediabetic.evidence: Example placeholder: guideline reference to be curated.

elevated.label: Elevated inflammatory marker
elevated.explanation: CRP is a non-specific inflammatory marker. Mild elevations can occur for many reasons (infection, chronic inflammation, recent intense exercise).
elevated.action: Consider context and, if persistent or high, discuss with a clinician. Avoid over-interpreting single CRP values in isolation.
